name: vc-test
description: PREVIEW — one testing flow for a Virto Commerce ticket: /ticket-context → change map → scored scenarios approved at one human point → one agent per scenario plus a background AC run → triage → Medium-only investigation → verdict, with tokens and minutes per step. /vc-test:init declares which environments a run may write to and the project's knowledge store. Until P1d moves /ticket-context and /qa-test-strategy into the plugin, /vc-test:qa-ticket runs only in a checkout of the ai-tools repository. Depends on vc-init (profile, $VC_RUN, the script runner) and vc-fix.
